messages:
Mira (CSM): @channel quick kickoff for Pelago onboarding — want to align stakeholders, success criteria, and an initial timeline. short: pilot -> 30d check -> 90d go/no-go :wave:
Tom G (Success Eng): Hi! I'll own infra and onboarding runbook. Need tokens + network whitelist from Pelago. ETA target: 2026-03-28 for dev sandbox access.
Sasha (Product): We'll hand over a small eval suite (sample prompts + metrics). Propose baseline success: p95 latency < 400ms, error rate < 0.5%, and embedding similarity > 0.78 on their eval set.
Ellie (Enablement): I'll run two enablement sessions: week 1 sandbox walkthrough and week 3 production runbook. Also will draft a short FAQ for Gina's team.
Mira (CSM): Customer contact is Gina (pelago) — I've intro'd us via email. Suggested weekly 30-min sync Tuesdays 9am PT. Works?
Tom G (Success Eng): Works for engineering. I'll post a preflight checklist in #customer-success and add a JIRA epic.
deploy-bot: Meeting created: Pelago onboarding kickoff — 2026-03-25 16:00 PT. Invite sent to internal attendees.
Sasha (Product): Also flagging a potential product gap: Pelago wants streaming responses + structured JSON output for downstream parsing. We should confirm model + function-calling approach in the kickoff.
Mira (CSM): Renewal risk: Pelago noted finance alignment concerns for annual commit. Short-term mitigation: offer a 6-month pilot pricing and a >30d usage review. Finance looped in separately.
Ellie (Enablement): For feedback capture I'll share a 3-question form after week 2 and collect runbook notes after week 4.
Mira (CSM): Quick action items (making these explicit):
```
- Tom: dev tokens & whitelist by 2026-03-28
- Sasha: sample prompts + eval harness by 2026-03-26
- Ellie: enablement sessions scheduled + feedback form live by week 2
- Mira: schedule weekly sync, confirm invite list, finance follow-up (renewal risk)
```
Mira (CSM): If anyone has objections to the timeline or wants different owners, say now. otherwise i'll lock these and share an official kickoff doc. :thumbsup:
